label_as_filed: There were 26 Covered Entities that together generated the top 90% of statewide net 340B revenue in Minnesota. However, as noted throughout this report, reported data are incomplete as most entities reported only pharmacy-dispensed drugs instead of both office-administered and pharmacy-dispensed drugs. Therefore, the list and any associated rankings presented in Appendix Table 5 do not represent full information, and entities that submitted complete data (both administered and dispensed drugs) are likely attributed a greater percentage of statewide net 340B revenue than if all entities had reported office-administered drugs.
